info.title: Apibara Copart & IAAI Vehicle Auction API
info.description:
Structured JSON API for Copart and IAAI vehicle auction data. Search auction vehicles, retrieve VIN and lot details, photos, prices, auction status, sale history, related vehicles, filters, locations, usage information, image proxy responses, and auction-to-port shipping prices.

Canonical public facts: 20M+ indexed current and retained historical auction records; 3.2M+ supported vehicle records represented in the dataset; approximately 30K+ records added or refreshed daily; supported price/status refresh up to 15 minutes and often sooner; supported live-bid refresh about 10–15 seconds. Indexed records are not a unique-VIN count; source-dependent fields can be null.

x-apibara-facts.indexedRecordsMeaning: Current and retained historical auction records; not a unique-VIN or unique-vehicle count.

get.description:
Search, filter, and paginate Copart and IAAI vehicle auction records. Cursor pagination is opaque: send the next_cursor returned by the API without decoding it. For incremental synchronization, use updated_within_minutes. Nullable/source-dependent fields are normal.

The endpoint exposes 43 documented query controls, including 40 search, filtering and synchronization controls. Use `updated_within_minutes` with cursor pagination and auction source/mode/state filters for incremental synchronization.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: Search by lot number, VIN, or vehicle title.

parameters.name: lot_sub_status
parameters.description: Normalized lot sub-status. Open = active/open and not sold; Live = currently live when supported; Ended = ended/closed state.

parameters.name: upcoming
parameters.description: Upcoming selector. all = no restriction; only = only upcoming eligible lots; without = exclude upcoming lots. This does not override Open/Sold state logic.

parameters.name: updated_within_minutes
parameters.description: Return records whose updated_at changed within the requested number of minutes. Designed for incremental synchronization; combine with cursor pagination and auction filters.

parameters.name: auction_type
parameters.description: Numeric auction platform filter: 0 = all supported platforms, 1 = Copart, 2 = IAAI. Use either auction_type or platform in the same request.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Readable auction platform filter. Use copart or iaai. Use either platform or auction_type in the same request.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Vehicle color. Multiple values are supported.

parameters.name: fuel_type
parameters.description: Fuel type. Multiple values are supported.

parameters.name: transmission
parameters.description: Transmission type. Multiple values are supported.

parameters.name: cylinders
parameters.description: Number of cylinders. Multiple values are supported.

parameters.name: drive_type
parameters.description: Drive type. Multiple values are supported.

parameters.name: damage
parameters.description: Damage type. Multiple values are supported.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Records per vehicle-search page. Default 20. The effective maximum is plan-dependent; public plan entitlements can use maxima of 20, 30 or 40, while approved custom plans may differ. Use the active account entitlement as the runtime source of truth.

parameters.name: today_only
parameters.description: Return only vehicles with auctions today.

parameters.name: has_shipping_price
parameters.description: Return only vehicles with shipping price data.

200.description: Paginated list of vehicle auction records.

400.description: Bad request. One or more parameters are invalid.

429.description: API quota exceeded or rate limit reached.

x-codeSamples.label: curl
x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request GET \
  --url "https://apibara.tech/api/v1/vehicle-auction/vehicles" \
  --header "Accept: application/json" \
  --header "X-API-Key: ${APIBARA_API_KEY}"

x-codeSamples.label: Python httpx
x-codeSamples.source:
import os, httpx

url = "https://apibara.tech/api/v1/vehicle-auction/vehicles"
headers = {"X-API-Key": os.environ["APIBARA_API_KEY"], "Accept": "application/json"}
response = httpx.request("GET", url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())
